description:
Part of epic ag-o6z; read it first. Needs ag-o6z.2 (runs without telemetry).

## Goal

Each run records its jobs and steps with their conclusions, so a person can see e.g. that "Audit with Claude" and "Open a PR with the fixes" were `skipped` (the gate skipped the run), or which step failed.

## Decision

One API call when the run completes, not a `workflow_job` subscription (epic, decision 4). The App already has Actions: read.

## Where the code is

- internal/core/model.go: Backend interface, Run. internal/github/github.go: Backend (go-github client per installation, see GetRunAttempt). internal/core/service_test.go: fakeBackend to extend.
- internal/core/worker.go: ApplyLifecycle, Reconcile.
- internal/web/templates.html `run`; internal/web/server.go.

## What to build

1. Backend.ListJobs(ctx, deployment, runID, attempt) → `GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/runs/{run_id}/attempts/{attempt}/jobs` (go-github: Actions.ListWorkflowJobsAttempt), all pages (per_page 100).
2. Run gets `Jobs []Job` (omitempty): Job {ID, Name, Status, Conclusion, StartedAt, CompletedAt, RunnerName, URL (html_url), Steps []Step}; Step {Number, Name, Status, Conclusion, StartedAt, CompletedAt}. Caps: 50 jobs, 100 steps per job, names cut to 200 chars. Pointers or omitempty for missing times.
3. When a run first becomes terminal, fetch jobs outside the DB transaction, then save them in a short transaction. If the call fails, leave Jobs missing; Reconcile retries runs that finished in the last 24 h with no Jobs. Do it once: a run with Jobs is not fetched again.
4. Run page: "Jobs and steps" section, one table per job (name, conclusion badge, start/end), steps in order. Steps numbers may jump (post steps such as 28, 29); show them as given. A reusable workflow's job is named like "audit / audit".

## Docs

docs/10-design.md Data (runs) and Flow; docs/20-routes.md `GET /runs/{id}`; glossary Configuration/Run if useful.

## How to check

- Unit test conversion from go-github jobs; DB test that a completed run gets jobs once and that a failed call is retried by Reconcile.
- After deploy: xpmatteo/rpg-interpreter run 38696780798-like skip shows the gate step success and the rest skipped.

## Open questions for Matt

None known.

comments.text: Built on branch ag-o6z.3/jobs-and-steps, commit e7692be (not merged, not pushed). No migration: Run.Jobs []Job with json 'jobs,omitzero' (nil = unknown, no key; [] = GitHub listed none, kept as an answer); Job/Step times omitzero. Backend.ListJobs (github: ListWorkflowJobsAttempt, per_page 100, stops at 50 jobs, max 5 pages, a failed page = error and no jobs, empty = []). core/jobs.go: FetchJobs selects terminal runs with no jobs key finished in the last 24 h (COALESCE(github_completed_at, updated_at column)), newest first, at most 5 GitHub calls per pass, skips runs in backoff; call outside tx; saveJobs re-reads FOR UPDATE and sets Jobs only if still nil and terminal. Backoff in memory (Service.jobsRetries): 1 min doubling to 1 h, forgotten on restart; 24 h window ends retries (stale installation). Trigger: Webhook, after a handled delivery with a finished state, sends a non-blocking signal on a 1-slot channel; Work's loop runs FetchJobs on it; Reconcile also calls FetchJobs after polling. So the webhook response never waits on GitHub. limitJobs: 50 jobs, 100 steps, names/status/conclusion/runner cut to 200 runes on a UTF-8 boundary (invalid bytes dropped), URL kept only if https://github.com/ and <=500 bytes. Run page: 'Jobs and steps' after Agent runs: one panel per job (linked name, outcome badge = conclusion or status, start/end, runner), steps table with numbers as given; missing times 'Unavailable'; notes for [] / unknown (finished) / not finished; note when a limit was reached. Docs: design (Parts, Flow 8, new 'Jobs and steps' section, Data runs, Limits), routes (run page), glossary (Run). Tests: limitJobs, JSON nil-vs-empty round trip, backoff, github ListJobs conversion/paging/empty/failure/stop at cap, DB: jobs once + failed call retried by Reconcile after delay + webhook wakes worker, empty list not re-fetched, bounds (old run, approval, running, past window, per pass, newest first), web page. make test passes with DB tests.

Review triage 2026-10-15. Fix now: drop wake channel (Reconcile every 30 s is enough; also lowers stale-snapshot risk), don't save while any job is not completed, no backoff on ctx errors, test updated_at fallback, nil job guard, Trust sentence on untrusted job/step names, clock comment. No action: truncation flag (keep the 'may list more' guess; a stored bool jobs_truncated would be the way if Matt wants exact), Step.Number 0, page loop. Note: two instances during a deploy may make one extra GitHub call; saveJobs stores once.

title: Record the jobs and steps of each run when it completes
